entries.desc: The created execution plan states that LATTICE_SESSION_ID is the canonical owner lease identity used by core owner-session logic, and linked contract docs repeat that host-specific session variables must be bridged before core lease handling.

evidence.note: The execution plan and linked lease decision document state that LATTICE_SESSION_ID is canonical and that core owner-lease logic should consume the canonical id.

entries.desc: The plan documents degraded identity behavior: ppid-derived identity is allowed only as a last-resort fallback when LATTICE_SESSION_ID is absent, and the user-visible source should make that degraded fallback clear.

evidence.note: The plan labels ppid identity as a degraded last fallback and requires user-visible source labeling when canonical host identity is absent.

entries.desc: A reviewer challenges a parent-PID-changing invocation path and the documentation still requires stable ownership through LATTICE_SESSION_ID, with ppid fallback treated as non-canonical and insufficient for the normal multi-host contract.

evidence.command: rg -n "Canonical env wins|ppid degradation|same worktree but different ppid|derived ids differ|stable ownership" docs/requirements/decisions/owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md
evidence.note: The verification matrix explicitly covers parent-PID-changing invocations: canonical env remains stable, while ppid-only runs are documented as degraded and insufficient for normal multi-host ownership.

entries.desc: The execution plan defines a host adapter bridge table or equivalent section for Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts, with each host producing or forwarding a stable value into LATTICE_SESSION_ID before owner lease logic runs.

evidence.note: The plan documents Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity/agy, and future hosts as adapter-layer providers that bridge to LATTICE_SESSION_ID before owner lease logic.

entries.desc: The plan gives onboarding rules for hosts that lack a native stable session variable: generate or map a host-local stable session id in the adapter layer, export it as LATTICE_SESSION_ID, and document the source shown to users.

evidence.command: rg -n "Generated-token fallback|future host onboarding|generate|adapter layer|source shown" docs/requirements/decisions/owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md
evidence.note: The plan covers hosts without a native stable session variable by generating or mapping a host-local stable id in the adapter layer and labeling the source shown to users.

entries.desc: The plan explicitly forbids adding Codex, Claude, agy, or future host special cases to core owner lease code; host-specific variables are resolved only by adapters before the core sees LATTICE_SESSION_ID.

evidence.command: rg -n "core owner-lease code must not|core owner-lease resolver|special cases|Core exception guard|host-specific env" docs/requirements/decisions/owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md docs/guide-scope-guard.md
evidence.note: The plan explicitly forbids Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and future-host special cases in core owner-lease logic; provider-specific knowledge is constrained to adapters and guard diagnostics.

entries.desc: The rollout section defines a verification matrix covering ppid-changing command invocations, wrapper environment bridging, owner lease refresh behavior, session_brief owner/source rendering, and documentation grep checks before runtime work ships.

evidence.note: The verification matrix covers ppid-changing invocations, wrapper env bridging, owner lease refresh behavior, session_brief source rendering, and documentation grep checks.

entries.desc: The execution plan includes manual transcript evidence instructions for running the same story-scoped commands through at least two invocation shapes that change parent PID while preserving LATTICE_SESSION_ID and owner lease continuity.

evidence.command: rg -n "Manual Transcript Evidence|two invocation shapes|parent PID|preserve LATTICE_SESSION_ID|degraded ppid-only run" docs/requirements/decisions/owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md
evidence.note: The plan requires manual transcript evidence for at least two invocation shapes that change parent PID while preserving LATTICE_SESSION_ID, plus a degraded ppid-only comparison run.
